content: qemu aarch64 -kernel has two paths: ELF files load as bare-metal (jump to ELF entry, DTB at 0x40000000) while non-ELF raw images must follow the arm64 Linux boot protocol (ARM\x64 magic at header offset 0x38, text_offset, entered with MMU off at EL2-or-EL1). Multiboot is x86-only and irrelevant on aarch64. 9legacy's unix harness boots an ELF kernel with multiboot on x86 - that pattern does not transfer to arm64. Harvey's k10 kernel is entered via multiboot (main(u32int ax, u32int bx)) so the aarch64 port needs a new entry contract.
